That's the problem. The cross-functional conference where Product, Research, Design and Engineering decide what's actually worth building. Tickets Get Tickets → Explore agenda Building requires judgment. And judgment requires shipping. Shipping fast means working across silos. As roles merge, the highest-impact people don’t stay in their lane. Here's how UXDX helps. Every discipline Cross-functional Multiple roles on one agenda because you’re expected to have all of these skills now. “ The best conference that cohesively addresses UX, PM and development . ” Jessica Cheong Experience Design Lead , Sage Talks Insight & inspiration Learn what is actually happening from the industry leading companies, sharing real case studies. “ We looked at every UX conference in the world, but none had speakers of the same calibre. ” Kevin Richardson UX Team Lead , CEF Workshops Skills The talks teach you what you need, the workshops teach you how to apply it. “ Once we reorganised, based on workshop learnings, delivery speed skyrocketed . ” Charlotte Whitaker Learning Analytics Project Manager , Imperial College London Check out the Agenda → Announcing our first speakers.
